summary: Reproduced the reported layer_idx=None scatter_add_ dimension mismatch through the checked-out DSparkV4Stage._run_ffn and real EPLB stat gatherer. Isolated only the DSpark draft MoE call from the target model's expert distribution recorder, preserving target statistics and recorder state.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual DSpark _run_ffn and stat gatherer raised RuntimeError: Index tensor must have the same number of dimensions as self tensor for both recording-active and capture-active hook modes.
Three CPU regressions passed: target counts and draft output preservation in recording/capture-active modes, restoration after an MoE exception, and preservation of an enclosing disabled region.
Two neighboring DSpark target-hidden projection tests passed.

A real HIP graph captured and replayed the fixed DSpark recorder seam on AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950; output exactly equaled input+1, target counts remained [[0,0,0,0],[2,0,4,0]], and recorder state was restored.
All applicable repository hooks passed, including AST checks, isort, ruff, ruff-format, codespell, and registered-test validation.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash model weights were unavailable, so no full model server startup, semantic accuracy, speculative acceptance, or live EPLB migration was tested.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; the reported 8xH20 TP=8/EP=8 deployment was not reproduced.
The GPU check substitutes inexpensive MoE arithmetic while exercising the actual DSpark _run_ffn, recorder hook, stat gatherer, and HIP graph capture/replay seam.
The separate DSpark draft expert-location dispatch correctness concern described in issue #34846 is outside this fix.
